$comment: FICTIONAL SAMPLE DATA for the IAMCP GitHub hands-on workshop. Fabrikam Consulting GmbH is not a real company and these rates are not an offer. Replace this file with your own rate card before any real use.
day_definition: One person day equals 8 working hours.
notes: All daily rates are net amounts and exclude value-added tax.
Travel and expenses are not included and are charged at cost after prior approval.
A role that is not listed in this rate card has no agreed rate. Ask the account manager for the rate instead of estimating one.
Discounts require written approval by sales management and are documented in the SOW, not in this rate card.

Designs the end-to-end solution and owns architecture decisions.
Designs cloud platforms, landing zones, networking and identity.
Builds generative AI agents, prompt flows, evaluations and model integrations.
Analyses data, develops models and defines evaluation metrics.
Assesses threats, designs security controls and supports compliance evidence.
Leads workstreams, analyses processes and shapes solutions together with the customer.
Implements complex features, reviews code and mentors developers.
Builds data pipelines, data models and data quality checks.
Builds CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and observability.
Elicits and documents requirements, processes and acceptance criteria.
Facilitates the agile delivery process and removes impediments.
Designs user journeys, prototypes and accessible user interfaces.
Plans and automates tests and reports quality findings.
Writes user, operations and training documentation.
Prepares and delivers training sessions and enablement material.
